purpose: One alternate method per failed type, not repetition of clothing-conditioned edit.
changed: No source PNG or whole-outfit conditioning; surface-only vocabulary; placement kept in separate ledger. Blue-grey is topology-study proxy, not canonical cloth colour.

types.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A clean sculptural material study of ONE small blue-grey fabric surface, on uniform opaque pale-grey paper. Do not depict any person, clothing item, trousers, leg, sleeve, anatomy, mannequin, silhouette locator, or assembled object. The subject is only a single thin tapered quadrilateral sheet, gently curved ACROSS its width into a shallow open trough, with a small broad bend along its length. One upper corner has a small concave cutout. Both long edges are completely FREE and widely separated; both short edges are incomplete OPEN ARCS with no closing chord and no circumferential rim. The opposite wall does not exist. Show the same one-surface sculpture in four isolated angles in a row: convex outside, true side profile, concave reverse, three-quarter looking clearly into the open trough. The last view must let the pale background be seen through the entirely missing opposite half. This is like a curved piece of cloth held in shape, not a hollow cylindrical object. One soft surface, four visible boundaries, no rolled edges, no ornamental stitches, no extra fold, no end caps. High quality neutral art reference. Labels only "TR01 / SURFACE STUDY", "OUTSIDE", "PROFILE", "REVERSE", "THREE-QUARTER". No dimensions or placement diagram.

Use case: stylized-concept. One isolated shallow blue-grey cloth surface study on fully opaque pale-grey paper. No person, garment, trousers, leg, sleeve, mannequin, anatomical cue, or placement locator anywhere. A single long tapered quadrilateral cloth sheet, a little wider at its upper end, with one gentle rounded bulge in its upper third and a subtle broad bend halfway down. The sheet is curved across its width, like a HALF-PIPE WITH THE OTHER HALF COMPLETELY REMOVED; it has TWO visibly separated long free edges for its ENTIRE length. The four-edge boundary never forms a circular opening: both short ends are open arcs, not round or oval rims. Show one and the same thin open surface from convex outside, true side, concave reverse and a three-quarter view looking into the wide open missing half. Pale background is visible through that missing half, which must not be filled by a second wall or a shadow. No rolled edges, closed tube, seam decoration, endcap or extra patch. Single simple surface concept art, not a measured engineering diagram. Labels only "TR02 / SURFACE STUDY", "OUTSIDE", "PROFILE", "REVERSE", "THREE-QUARTER".
